captured_via: gh 2.98.0, live user-owned board; project and field node ids anonymized and the field LIST TRIMMED to 4 of the 13 the board carries (the `totalCount: 13` beside them is the board's real count, deliberately left honest) — option ids, key set and shapes verbatim
notes: Only ProjectV2SingleSelectField carries `options`; the adapter refuses any other field type for status write-back rather than writing a free-text value.
Option ids are short opaque hex, unlike the base64-ish node ids — both are passed through verbatim to `item-edit`.

Board columns are user-authored: this one has Blocked/Review, GitHub's stock template has only Todo/In Progress/Done, and a non-English board has none of those spellings. That variance is why _ALIASES and the Unicode-aware key comparison exist.

`item-edit` and `item-create` are the two verbs with NO capture anywhere in this fixture set: both need the wider `project` OAuth scope (reads need only `read:project`) and capturing them would mutate a live board. Their response handling in github_projects_cli.py is defensive by assumption, not by observation.
